page.notes: Printed in a heavy italic with long s; the ligature & and the Greek-style abbreviations are kept as printed. The signature line "Ss s" and catchword "Somno" are read from the foot. Some entries are set in a damaged area with uncertain letters, notably "Sitis potusq;" and "Serpentes ... praparandi modus", where the spacing is irregular.
